title: Explanation-Aware Fairness Beyond Output Parity: Joint Output-Attribution Regularization for Medical Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.13052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Output-level fairness does not constrain whether demographic groups rely on similar predictive contributions in representation space. For a nonlinear encoder with a linear head, we show that outcome-conditioned output score disparity equals the signed sum of feature attribution differences across subgroups by allowing small prediction gaps to arise through cancellation effect. We test whether an attribution disparity penalty complements output-level equalized odds based fairness surrogates. Across 960 DINOv2-LoRA models on HAM10000 and Harvard-GF datasets for gender and race fairness, attribution augmentation increases utility-fairness trade-off performance for hypervolume in six different settings with paired 95% confidence intervals and relative gains of 1.49-10.57%. translated_title: 超越输出一致的解释感知公平性：面向医学图像分类的联合输出-归因正则化
translated_abstract: 输出层面的公平性并不约束不同人口群体在表示空间中是否依赖相似的预测贡献。对于带有线性头的非线性编码器，我们证明了以结果为条件的输出分数差异等于各子群之间特征归因差异的带符号之和，这使得微小的预测差距可以通过抵消效应产生。我们检验了归因差异惩罚是否能补充基于输出级均衡几率的公平性代理方法。在 HAM10000 与 Harvard-GF 数据集上针对性别与种族公平性训练的 960 个 DINOv2-LoRA 模型上，在六种不同设置中（均配有配对 95% 置信区间），归因增强提升了效用-公平性权衡的超体积性能，相对增益为 1.49%-10.57%。在预定义的效用约束下，经过增强的模型族还实现了低 9.0%-38.7% 的均衡几率差异、更低的归因差异，以及更少的抵消效应。
tldr: 本文提出一种联合输出-归因正则化方法，通过惩罚不同人口群体间的特征归因差异来补充输出层面的均衡几率公平约束，在医学图像分类任务上显著改善了效用与公平性的权衡表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a joint output-attribution regularization that penalizes feature attribution disparities across demographic groups to complement output-level equalized-odds fairness, substantially improving the utility-fairness trade-off in medical image classification.
